verbs.description: Describe a picture What it shows, in a sentence. The picture is sent to the provider the AI settings hub chose, which keeps the key this device uses; the model that answered is the image model's own reading.
verbs.label: Describe a picture

verbs.description: Read the text in a picture The words it holds, read on this device. Needs no language model, so it answers on a device with none.
verbs.label: Read the text in a picture

verbs.description: Name what a picture shows The objects and pets in it, as words: the objects first, then the pets, from the same model `describe` asks.
verbs.label: Name what a picture shows

verbs.description: Find pictures of the same face The groups of pictures a face model found the same face in, each a list of the pictures' addresses. The model never receives a name, a person or a photograph's own id: each picture is named by its address here.
verbs.label: Find pictures of the same face

types.doc: One picture the analysis could not do, and why.
types.name: AnalysisFailure

verbs.description: Analyze the library's pictures Analyze every picture the system index holds and add what each shows to its entry in search. Pixels stay on this device; only the bounded result is shared.
verbs.label: Analyze the library's pictures

verbs.description: Pause the analysis Stop after the picture in progress; `resume` continues it.
verbs.label: Pause the analysis

verbs.description: Resume the analysis Continue a paused run without widening its queue.
verbs.label: Resume the analysis

verbs.description: Retry the pictures that failed Analyze only the pictures whose last analysis failed, without starting the whole library again.
verbs.label: Retry the pictures that failed

verbs.description: Stop the analysis Stop before the next picture. What was analyzed stays analyzed.
verbs.label: Stop the analysis
